Inclass exercise 07

Installing catchment R packages from github.

Code 
remotes::install_github('uva-bi-sdad/catchment')

Load sf, tidyverse, tmap acc and catchment packages.

Code 
pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, tmap, accessibility, catchment)

Loading data:

Code 
mpsz <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "MP14_SUBZONE_NO_SEA_PL") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)

Code 
hexagons <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "hexagons") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)

eldercare <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "ELDERCARE") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
Reading layer `ELDERCARE' from data source 
  `C:\hungthq\ISSS626-GAA\In-class_Ex\In-class_Ex07\data\geospatial'

Import OD matrix

Code 
ODMatrix <- read_csv("data/aspatial/OD_Matrix.csv", skip = 0)

Tidy up the data

Code 
distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost)%>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))


distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)

Use the code chunk below to create a new field called capacity in eldercare sf data frame and populate 100 in it.

Code 
eldercare <- eldercare %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(capacity = 100)

hexagons <- hexagons %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(demand = 100) %>%
  rename(id = fid)

Rename the column id

Code 
ODMatrix_tidied <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  rename(from_id = origin_id,
         to_id = destination_id,
         dist = total_cost)

Computing Minimum Travel Distace to nearest oldercare

Code 
dist2closest <- cost_to_closest(
  travel_matrix = ODMatrix_tidied,
  land_use_data = hexagons,
  opportunity = "demand",
  travel_cost = "dist",
  n = 1,
  group_by = character(0),
  active = TRUE,
  fill_missing_ids = TRUE
)

Append the computed closest distance values to hexagons sf data frame.

Code 
hex_acc <- hexagons %>%
  left_join(dist2closest) %>%
  rename(dist2closest = dist)

Chotolepth map showing the distribution of closest values in dist field.

Code 
mapex <- st_bbox(hex_acc)
tm_shape(hex_acc,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "dist2closest", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
  tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("Accessibility to the closest eldercare") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)

Converting ODMatrix data frame in a matrix

Code 
distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost)%>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))

distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)

Two-Step Floating Catchment Area

Code 
df_2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  max_cost = 5) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("2SFCA" = ".")

Mapping 2SFCA

Code 
hex_2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_2sfca) 
tm_shape(hex_2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "2SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
  tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)

Enhanced 2-Step Floating Catchment Area (E2SFCA)

Code 
step_weights <- list(c(5, .01), c(4, .05), c(3, .1), c(2, .4), c(1, 1))
df_e2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand, 
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  weight = step_weights) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("E2SFCA" = ".")

Mapping E2SFCA

Code 
hex_E2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_e2sfca)

              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",

  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("E2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)

## Inclass exercise 07

Installing catchment R packages from github.

```{r}
remotes::install_github('uva-bi-sdad/catchment')
```

Load sf, tidyverse, tmap acc and catchment packages.

```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, tmap, accessibility, catchment)
```

Loading data:

```{r}
mpsz <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "MP14_SUBZONE_NO_SEA_PL") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)

hexagons <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "hexagons") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)

eldercare <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "ELDERCARE") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)

```

Import OD matrix

```{r}
ODMatrix <- read_csv("data/aspatial/OD_Matrix.csv", skip = 0)
```

Tidy up the data

```{r}
distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost)%>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))


distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)
```

Use the code chunk below to create a new field called capacity in eldercare sf data frame and populate 100 in it.

```{r}
eldercare <- eldercare %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(capacity = 100)

hexagons <- hexagons %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(demand = 100) %>%
  rename(id = fid)
```

Rename the column id

```{r}
ODMatrix_tidied <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  rename(from_id = origin_id,
         to_id = destination_id,
         dist = total_cost)
```

## Computing Minimum Travel Distace to nearest oldercare

```{r}
dist2closest <- cost_to_closest(
  travel_matrix = ODMatrix_tidied,
  land_use_data = hexagons,
  opportunity = "demand",
  travel_cost = "dist",
  n = 1,
  group_by = character(0),
  active = TRUE,
  fill_missing_ids = TRUE
)

```

Append the computed closest distance values to *hexagons* sf data frame.

```{r}
hex_acc <- hexagons %>%
  left_join(dist2closest) %>%
  rename(dist2closest = dist)
```

Chotolepth map showing the distribution of closest values in *dist* field.

```{r}
mapex <- st_bbox(hex_acc)
tm_shape(hex_acc,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "dist2closest", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
  tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("Accessibility to the closest eldercare") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

## Converting ODMatrix data frame in a matrix

```{r}
distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost)%>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))

distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)
```

## Two-Step Floating Catchment Area

```{r}
df_2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  max_cost = 5) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("2SFCA" = ".")


```

**Mapping 2SFCA**

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
hex_2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_2sfca) 
tm_shape(hex_2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) + 
  tm_polygons(fill = "2SFCA", 
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
  tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```
